name: ai-playgrounds
description: Explore and experiment with 15 multilingual, offline-ready AI applets for hands-on learning through controlled trials and inspection.

paragraphs: Welcome to ai-playgrounds! This is a free collection of interactive laboratories designed to help you understand artificial intelligence in a hands-on way. You don't need any programming skills – just curiosity and a computer running Windows. Think of it like a science museum for AI, where you can click, drag, and explore how intelligent systems actually work.
ai-playgrounds is an educational toolkit that brings complex AI concepts to life. Instead of reading dry textbooks, you'll experiment with visual playgrounds covering:
Each lab is fully interactive, with sliders, buttons, and real-time visual feedback. It's designed for teachers, students, or anyone curious about how AI works behind the scenes.
features: Search Algorithms – See how computers find the best path through mazes
Logic & Reasoning – Tinker with rule-based systems
Probability & Statistics – Understand how AI makes predictions
Machine Learning Basics – Train simple models with your mouse
Neural Networks – Watch how layers of "neurons" recognize patterns
